# PrismLauncher Fork {{VERSION}} (Windows)

This release packages the current Windows build of this PrismLauncher fork.

## Highlights

- Built from the current fork release branch with a Windows installer attached.
- Includes the launcher's built-in offline account flow and offline launch mode.
- Microsoft account login remains available for normal online play when desired.

## Offline Account Notes

- You can add an offline account from the account manager using `Add Offline`.
- You can also launch in offline mode when you want a local/offline profile.
- Offline mode is intended for offline/local use; online authentication still uses Microsoft account login.

## Included Asset

- `PrismLauncher-Windows-MSVC-Setup-{{VERSION}}.exe` - Windows installer

## Current Scope

- This release only publishes the Windows installer asset.
- Linux, macOS, and additional package variants are intentionally disabled for this release pipeline.
